legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: All training must reflect safe working practices under UK health and safety expectations.
content_rules: Promote safe work practices at all times
Model appropriate use of safety equipment
scenario_rules: Scenarios must include realistic workplace hazards
Unsafe decisions must result in corrective outcomes
assessment_rules: Correct answers must align with safe practices

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Personal data must be treated confidentially and responsibly under UK GDPR requirements.
content_rules: Use fictional or anonymised personal data
scenario_rules: Confidential data must not be shared casually
assessment_rules: Do not require real personal information
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Using real learner data in examples

legislation_groups.summary_for_ai: Training must be inclusive and free from bias, reflecting UK Equality Act principles.
scenario_rules: Discrimination must never be presented as acceptable

prompt_injection_block.system_instruction: All content must comply with UK health and safety, data protection (GDPR), and equality requirements. Use British English spelling.
